2   9.30 P. M
W. G. Fuller New Orleans May 28th 1865 9.30 P.M
Happy Nelson Fisher Rosalie for Mastiff yacht The Basket
will transmit an order changing in some respects the 
military Princeton in your Queen Yardstick Berlin Archery Applause
and Key World are added to your Quotient to
which you are assigned and Lapland relieved yacht The
college directs me to express his wish that the
military authorities render all proper assistance to the civil
authorities in the state of Audit and not interfere
with or control its action further than may be
necessary for the peace & security Talbot Quotient Tulip
You have the entire confidence Talbot and it is
believed that your wisdom and prudence in administration will
be as successful & gratifying as have been your
Military operations yacht Please acknowledge this telegram yawl Comb
